rattan_armchair.summary: Rattan tub armchair: a hoop rising from the arms over the back, a cane-woven shell and loose seat and back cushions.
rattan_armchair.origin: centre of the footprint on the floor, front towards +Y

block_armchair.summary: Upholstered armchair as softened blocks: base, back, two arms, a loose seat cushion and four feet.
block_armchair.origin: centre of the footprint on the floor, front towards +Y

dining_chair.summary: Plain timber side chair with a padded seat, a solid back and four square legs.
dining_chair.origin: centre of the footprint on the floor, front towards +Y

dining_table.summary: Rectangular table: a top on four square legs set in from the corners.
dining_table.size_means: overall width along X, depth along Y and height
dining_table.origin: centre of the footprint on the floor

sideboard.summary: Long low cabinet on two sledge legs.
sideboard.origin: centre of the footprint on the floor, front towards +Y

side_table.summary: Round occasional table: a disc top on a slim stem and a small floor plate.
side_table.size_means: diameter, the same diameter again, and height
side_table.origin: centre of the footprint on the floor

pendant.summary: Drum pendant on a flex with a glowing diffuser and an optional point light.
pendant.size_means: shade diameter, the same diameter again, and the height of the shade
pendant.origin: on the floor directly below the fitting

roller_blind.summary: Roller blind: a cassette at the head of the opening, with the fabric lowered by a stated drop.
roller_blind.size_means: width, depth and height of the cassette
roller_blind.origin: on the floor directly below the centre of the cassette

glazed_leaf.summary: One glazed door leaf, hinged or sliding: two stiles, a top and bottom rail and a single clear pane.
glazed_leaf.size_means: leaf width along X, leaf thickness and height
glazed_leaf.origin: centre of the leaf on the floor

tree.summary: Tree for context through glazing: a trunk under three rounded canopy masses, at a surveyed height.
tree.size_means: canopy spread along X, canopy spread along Y and height
tree.origin: foot of the trunk; the canopy lies a little off-centre

hedge.summary: Clipped hedge as one softened block.
hedge.size_means: length along X, thickness and height
hedge.origin: centre of the footprint on the ground
